title: Torsion de Reidemeister pour les variétés hyperboliques
container-title: Memoirs of the American Mathematical Society
note: Mem. Amer. Math. Soc. 128 (1997), no. 612, x+139 pp. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1090/memo/0612) and Porti (2015, arXiv:1511.00400v2) bibliography (2026-11-28). Foundational construction of adjoint SL_2(C) Reidemeister torsion as a rational function on character varieties of cusped hyperbolic 3-manifolds, cusp peripheral change-of-curve formula (Prop. 4.10 / Cor. 4.18), and Dehn-filling asymptotics.
